operations.summary: Generate a closed, outward-oriented triangle surface mesh of a typed implicit domain (sphere, ellipsoid or torus; a fixed enumerated set, no free-form expressions) with CGAL Surface_mesher make_surface_mesh under angle, size (surface Delaunay ball radius) and distance criteria. Surface_mesher is a deprecated CGAL 6.2.1 package.
aliases: 陰関数曲面のメッシュ化
トーラスメッシュ生成

angle_bound.description: Lower bound in degrees for the facet angles (Surface_mesh_default_criteria_3 angular bound); 30 degrees is the Surface_mesher termination guarantee.

size_bound.description: Upper bound on the radius of the surface Delaunay balls (size / radius bound).

distance_bound.description: Upper bound on the distance between a facet circumcentre and the centre of its surface Delaunay ball; must not exceed 0.1 times the smallest curvature radius of the domain.

precision.predicate_policy: CGAL filtered-exact predicates (EPICK); independent validators use exact rational/orientation arithmetic

operations.summary: Independent check that a TriangleSurfaceMesh is a closed, connected, consistently outward-oriented 2-manifold of the typed implicit domain: vertices on the analytic surface, genus by Euler characteristic, angle, size and distance criteria, sampled distance bound, and analytic area and volume. It never calls Surface_mesher or Mesh_3.

angle_bound.description: Smallest facet angle in degrees the validator enforces.

size_bound.description: Largest facet circumradius (a necessary consequence of the surface Delaunay ball radius bound) the validator enforces.

distance_bound.description: Largest distance of a facet circumcentre from the analytic surface the validator enforces.

output_contract.independence: validator does not call CGAL Surface_mesher (make_surface_mesh), Mesh_3 or the implicit-surface oracle under test

precision.predicate_policy: CGAL filtered-exact predicates (EPICK); independent validators use exact rational/orientation arithmetic
